endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.integrable_gamma_positiveEdge_mass
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {m r : ℕ} (u : Fin m → RectangleCLT.Vector r),
  (∀ (k : Fin m), RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq (u k) = 1) →
    ∀ (a : RectangleCLT.Vector m) (h σ : ℝ) (x : RectangleCLT.Vector r) (j l : Fin m) (q : ℕ),
      MeasureTheory.Integrable
        (fun e =>
          RectangleCLTArxivV1.positiveEdgeTubeCoefficient u
            (fun k =>
              (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.gammaAdjustedThreshold a h e k - RectangleCLT.faceDot (u k) x) / σ)
            0 (j, l))
        (RectangleCLT.Companion.gammaRectangleLaw m q)

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.integrable_gaussian_positive_soft_pair_mass
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {m r : ℕ} (u : Fin m → RectangleCLT.Vector r) (a : RectangleCLT.Vector m) {h : ℝ},
  0 < h →
    ∀ (σ : ℝ) (x : RectangleCLT.Vector r) (j l : Fin m),
      MeasureTheory.Integrable
        (fun g =>
          RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.logisticNullWeight u a h (x + σ • g) *
              RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.logisticFaceWeight u a h (x + σ • g) j *
            RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.logisticFaceWeight u a h (x + σ • g) l)
        (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r)

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.integrable_gaussian_positive_soft_pair_projection
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {m r : ℕ} (u : Fin m → RectangleCLT.Vector r),
  (∀ (k : Fin m), RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq (u k) = 1) →
    ∀ (a : RectangleCLT.Vector m) {h : ℝ},
      0 < h →
        ∀ (σ : ℝ) (x : RectangleCLT.Vector r) (j l : Fin m),
          MeasureTheory.Integrable
            (fun g =>
              RectangleCLTArxivV1.correlationAngleWeight (RectangleCLT.faceDot (u j) (u l)) *
                (RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq ((RectangleCLTArxivV1.supplementalHPairPlane (u j) (u l)).mulVec g) *
                  (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.logisticNullWeight u a h (x + σ • g) *
                      RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.logisticFaceWeight u a h (x + σ • g) j *
                    RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.logisticFaceWeight u a h (x + σ • g) l)))
            (RectangleCLT.standardGaussian r)

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.positiveGamma_mass_angle_soft_coarea
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {m n : ℕ} (u : Fin m → RectangleCLT.Vector (n + 1)),
  (∀ (k : Fin m), RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq (u k) = 1) →
    ∀ (a : RectangleCLT.Vector m) {h σ : ℝ},
      0 < h →
        0 < σ →
          ∀ (x : RectangleCLT.Vector (n + 1)) (j l : Fin m),
            1 / h * (2 / h) *
                (RectangleCLTArxivV1.correlationAngleWeight (RectangleCLT.faceDot (u j) (u l)) *
                  ∫ (g : RectangleCLT.Vector (n + 1)),
                    RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.logisticNullWeight u a h (x + σ • g) *
                        RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.logisticFaceWeight u a h (x + σ • g) j *
                      RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.logisticFaceWeight u a h (x + σ • g)
                        l ∂RectangleCLT.standardGaussian (n + 1)) =
              σ⁻¹ *
                (σ⁻¹ *
                  ∫ (e : ℝ × (RectangleCLT.Face m → ℝ)),
                    RectangleCLTArxivV1.positiveEdgeTubeCoefficient u
                      (fun k =>
                        (RectangleCLT.Companion.SplitV4.gammaAdjustedThreshold a h e k - RectangleCLT.faceDot (u k) x) /
                          σ)
                      0 (j, l) ∂RectangleCLT.Companion.gammaRectangleLaw m 0)

endpoints.name: RectangleCLTArxivV1.positiveGammaSoftOrderedPairMass_concentrated_base
endpoints.expanded_type:
∀ {p m n : ℕ},
  1 ≤ p →
    ∀ (ν : MeasureTheory.Measure (RectangleCLT.Vector (n + 1))) [inst : MeasureTheory.IsProbabilityMeasure ν]
      (U : RectangleCLT.Face p → RectangleCLT.Vector (n + 1)) (f : Fin m → RectangleCLT.Face p)
      (a : RectangleCLT.Vector m) {K δ σ h : ℝ},
      0 ≤ K →
        0 ≤ δ →
          0 < σ →
            0 < h →
              (∀ (j : Fin m), RectangleCLT.vectorNormSq (U (f j)) = 1) →
                (∀ (b : RectangleCLT.Vector m) (s : ℝ),
                    0 < s → ν.real (RectangleCLTArxivV1.faceLayer (fun j => U (f j)) b s) ≤ K * (s + δ)) →
                  δ * √(RectangleCLT.dimensionLog p) ≤ σ →
                    MeasureTheory.Integrable
                        (RectangleCLTArxivV1.positiveGammaSoftOrderedPairMass (fun j => U (f j)) a h σ) ν ∧
                      ∫ (x : RectangleCLT.Vector (n + 1)),
                          RectangleCLTArxivV1.positiveGammaSoftOrderedPairMass (fun j => U (f j)) a h σ x ∂ν ≤
                        RectangleCLTArxivV1.positiveSoftPairMassConstant * h ^ 2 * K * √(RectangleCLT.dimensionLog p) /
                          σ
